hero.alt: A black G-Wagon on a brick drive before a stone estate, headlights on, pink sky behind.

intro:
Knock Em Down details cars where they sit, in driveways instead of a shop. Tidal Wave runs tunnels. Both of them sell a finish, so the pictures have to make the finish look worth paying for.

On location either way, on their schedule, working around customers.
